## How you checked it

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Ran the tests against real servers (`make db-up`, see CONTRIBUTING.md) — needed when touching queries, edits, read-only or SSH
- [ ] Tried it in the app on macOS / Windows / Linux (say which)
- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] Added a line to `CHANGELOG.md` if a user would notice the change
- [ ] Retook the screenshots (`make screenshots`) if the UI changed
